description: Hi! I’m a first-year Computer Science student from Zambia passionate about AI, software development, robotics and emerging technologies. I have experience in Python, Java, JavaScript, web development and CAD, alongside leadership experience in robotics. I’m looking for creative, curious and committed teammates with skills in coding, AI/ML, data analysis, Earth science, statistics, design and communications. You don’t have to be an expert; enthusiasm and willingness to learn matter!
